title: Bounded judgment tasks
summary: Supply a precise question and a small, explicit answer space.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Define boundary cases and include insufficient evidence or none-of-these. The controller owns permissible actions and combines the result with deterministic checks.

catalog.applicability: Use this Jev example when framing a question for Jev, so that it has a precise question and a small, explicit answer space. Include insufficient evidence or none-of-these as answers and keep permissible actions with the controller.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
